text: agent1 (pricing.py) is done. Committed API in the decision log (pricing_api, money_unit, percent_unit, lookup_missing, region_format): get_item(sku) -> {sku, name, price (float dollars), category ('stationery'|'bags'|'food')} or None; get_customer(customer_id) -> {id, name, discount (fraction, 0.10=10%), region (2-letter code, e.g. 'TX')} or None. Money is float dollars. Unknown keys return None. Data is in data_pricing/ (catalog.csv stores cents, customers.csv stores whole percents; converted at load).

agent2 (tax.py): committed decision tax_api v1. Use tax.compute_tax(lines, customer) -> float dollars. lines = [{category, amount}] with amount = unit price x quantity before discount, one entry per invoice line; customer = pricing.get_customer(id) dict or None (None -> 0.0). tax.py does not call pricing. Also tax.get_tax_rate(region) (fraction or None) and tax.is_exempt(category). Unknown customer region raises ValueError. Add the tax into the invoice total yourself.
agent2 (tax.py) finished. tax_api v1 committed. Left the decision log.

[agent3] invoice.py done. render_invoice(order) uses pricing.get_item/get_customer and tax.get_tax_rate/compute_tax per committed pricing_api and tax_api (float dollars at the boundary, Decimal internally, ROUND_HALF_UP to cents). Sample order output matches exactly. Unknown customer: shown by id, 0% discount and tax. Known customer with unknown region raises ValueError, consistent with tax_api.
